## API contract
- `GET /api/staff/immunizations/for-patient?id=<patientId>` (also accepts `patientId=`) — gate:
  CLINICAL_VIEWERS (perm.ts). Returns `{ given: [{id, vaccine, vaccineEn, doseLabel, givenAt, batch,
  site, nextDueAt}], due: [{code, ar, en, dose, dueAt, status: overdue|due|upcoming}], catalog:
  [{code, ar, en}] }`. Due logic: fixed series (BCG 0m; HepB 0/1/6m; OPV+DTaP 2/4/6m; MMR 12m;
  MMR/DTaP/OPV booster 18m) — next unsatisfied dose per vaccine (count-based matching via
  vaccineEn/vaccine alias keys, works with seed rows "شلل فموي (OPV)" etc.); annual FLU (age ≥6m,
  365d coverage) + COVID (age ≥144m); overdue = past due + 30d grace; MONTH_MS = 30.4375d
  (deterministic). Sorted overdue → due → upcoming, then dueAt.
- `POST /api/staff/immunizations/record` — gate: SIGNERS ∪ nurse (reuses `guardSign`). Body
  `{patientId, vaccine(code|ar|en), doseNo 1-9, date?, batch?, site?, nextDueAt?}`. Validates vaccine
  against whitelist (422 VACCINE_UNKNOWN), patient exists (404), date parseable (422 BAD_DATE).
  Stores vaccine=ar, vaccineEn=en, doseLabel=String(doseNo), givenBy=actor. Auto nextDueAt when not
  supplied: next series slot (dob + ageMonths) or +365d for FLU/COVID. Creates Immunization row +
  hash-chain audit (action create / resource immunization). Returns 201 `{id, nextDueAt}`.
- `GET /api/patient/immunizations` — patient session guard (patientActor). Scope: self + guardian
  dependants (PatientRelationship relatedId=self, relation=guardian). Returns rows with ownerAr/ownerEn
  names, vaccine, doseLabel, givenAt, nextDueAt (take 20, givenAt desc).
